model_description: Ensemble of 200 regularized decision trees (max_depth=8, min_samples_leaf=4) using bootstrap aggregation and balanced class weights to capture feature interactions.

selection_criteria.rationale: Random Forest achieved the highest 5-fold stratified cross-validation clinical screening score (0.7745), defined as 0.45×Recall + 0.35×ROC-AUC + 0.20×F1-Score on the training set. Prioritizing sensitivity (Recall) alongside ROC-AUC minimizes missed high-risk cases (False Negatives) while preserving reliable overall discrimination without peeking at the hold-out test set.

training_configuration.leakage_prevention: Train/test split performed before preprocessing. Invalid zero replacement, median imputation, and z-score standardization are encapsulated inside a scikit-learn Pipeline fitted exclusively on training folds.
